findings.text: No defect found in the assigned local chain/recovery and operations boundaries in these runs.
The prior deployment guide claim that file storage lacked durable anchor intents has been corrected; the current paragraph describes the local Anvil path and pending Sepolia receipt accurately.

limits: This proves only local code behavior on Anvil 31337. The chain and random signer are disposable; the receipt cannot be opened on a public explorer after Anvil stops.
No public service, Render runtime, HTTPS origin, remote filesystem durability, remote flock support, hosted backup/restore, or production access configuration was exercised by these three commands.
No Sepolia RPC, public registry, deployment, transaction, or receipt was used. Public Sepolia integration remains pending.
The CLI verifier runs in a separate process but uses the same chain implementation and configured node RPC; it is not an independently implemented verifier or independent node consensus check.
Receipt/hash evidence concerns integrity and version chronology only; it says nothing about physical methane measurements, repairs, or emissions reduction.
review_note: The suite's proxy branch records actual statuses and the accepted/reconciled hash. The nonce delta is asserted from two runtime reads but the runner artifact does not retain their numeric values. Full outputs are in the linked log files; no repository files were edited by this reviewer.
